verdicts.reason: A is clearly broken. The body copy is cut off at the top, so it starts mid-sentence at 'by hand in our…', and its first lines sit as dark text on the dark header band where they can't be read. The right column is also cramped against the canvas edge. Its good points are a large headline and logo and a readable CTA. B is a uniform shrink of the original, not a rearrangement. The logo is tiny, and the body copy, CTA label, 'Ships late June' and legal line are all illegible at this size, leaving large empty cream areas. Still, it keeps all the content, the reading order and the brand, with no collisions. That makes it the less bad of the two.
